changelog:
You can now stop the television from your phone.

WHAT CHANGED

- Stop on your television. While something you sent is playing on your
  paired PerchTV television, press and hold any channel or film and
  choose "Stop on" and your television's name. The television stops and
  says the phone stopped it. The option appears only while the
  television is actually playing, and it still appears after the app
  has been closed and reopened.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including sending to the television, the LIVE
  button, and recovery from dropped streams.
